description: Delivered 16 September 1970; registered 5 November 1970 as CCCP-87769 to the Tajik Civil Aviation Directorate at Dushanbe; struck off 25 December 1984 on expiry of service life; stored at Dushanbe airport and erected as a monument in the city in December 1998; the exact site within Dushanbe is not stated by the source; year_built from the delivery date
